scope: Actual native center-pin solid translations along world Y at saved neutral pose; finite insertion samples only; no full motion or package PASS.
shape_convention: Copied actual App::Link.Shape in world coordinates; no second LinkPlacement application
limits: 24 center-pin travel stations per joint/direction (4 paths); finite samples do not certify the continuous swept path or minimum clearance.
Parts in exclusions are separately modeled outer journal/capture hardware or deliberately deferred center retainers; no structural frame/torso body, bearing or cable is silently excluded.
The saved prescribed neutral pose is used; no access at other spine poses is claimed.
Center retainers and outer retaining clips require elastic installation; no rigid clip path, tool clearance, installation strain or removal/service access was evaluated.
Nominal bearing/spacer bore clearance is geometry only; supplier fit, bearing thrust/outer-race retention, coaxiality and strength remain unresolved.
No document recompute, placement assignment, source mutation, save or export occurred; all pin translations operated on shape copies only.
Supplemental installed CLI execution does not replace primary installed MCP evidence or establish full-package PASS.
assembly_sequence: At the saved neutral pose, support/align the torso and center lug with the center bearings and washers in their modeled locations; no fixture or hand/tool access qualification is claimed.

Defer both center retainers. On the chosen entry side, leave the existing outer E journal and its two retaining clips uninstalled; the opposite outer E stack may remain installed. Bearings and spacers need not be removed in the tested minimum-exclusion stage.
Translate the actual center pin along world Y from outside the whole assembly to its saved seated position. Each joint was tested from both sides at 24 travel stations.
Install the center retainers using a separately resolved elastic installation method; this operation and tool/service access are not established by the pin-path audit.
Install/retain the deferred entry-side outer E journal and its capture clips using the existing assembly procedure; their installation path and elastic clip behavior were not audited here.

finding_resolution.reason: Actual OCC intersections confirm both outer journal retainers and journal itself block side insertion. Deferring that entry-side journal/retainers plus center retainers produces zero >1e-5 mm³ intersections at all 24 sampled stations for each of four paths.
